line.comment: * Bait and Rescue missions incur double penalty if the player claimed the ship and is currently flying it. This is a safety, as destroying the PLAYERSHIP results in a game over.
* Police mission incurs double penalty if the player scanned and claimed the culprit.
* Delivery mission incurs double penalty if all stations are alive and the player is currently flying the delivery ship.
* -500 reputation and -1 Loyalty per penalty point.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Reputation penalty now scales with game difficulty on Hard and Insane.
* Loyalty Points are removed only if the player still has Loyalty after reputation loss.
* Don't use Mayhem.MissionEntry.Abort. Must properly remove the mission with Mayhem.Mission.Remove.
